unruled:dependent#1.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 19; p501 p. 18. The question is broader than the source taxpayer definition. An affirmative other_claimant answer refuses through qualifying_child, so the identified defect is over-refusal. New task T-153 preserves this older low finding for the dependent pass; it is not certified as a correctly scoped refusal.

unruled:dependent#2.evidence: Source: p501 p. 20; p501 p. 15; p501 p. 21. Existing low definition debt, not introduced by this package: T-107/T-109 now include the full remaining support list. dependent.supported already asks the over-half test, own funds actually spent, fair rental value, TANF, agency support, wages and scholarships. The insurance/excluded-items and rarer allocation/property rules remain explicitly deferred to the dependent pass; this ruling does not claim they are implemented or refused.

unruled:dependent#3.evidence: Source: p501 p. 20; p501 p. 21. Existing low support-definition debt, T-109: own funds actually spent covers spending savings, tax-exempt funds and borrowed money in substance, and fair rental value covers owned lodging. GI Bill and excluded-item details still need the source wording; the remaining support list is recorded in BUG-0282 for the dependent pass.

unruled:dependent#4.evidence: Source: p501 p. 13. The input asks whether the person was enrolled as a full-time student at a school; school co-op work as part of a regular course of classroom and practical training remains enrollment in its regular course, distinct from the excluded standalone on-the-job training course.

unruled:dependent#5.evidence: Source: p501 p. 13. The question counts a medical-care temporary absence and applies the born/died part-year convention. A required hospital stay after birth is medical care, not a second main home. This matches the prior ruling; T-106 remains the owner-batched request to state the hospital clause expressly. No newly introduced question change is being excused.

unruled:dependent#6.evidence: Source: p501 p. 9. The household half is fixed in this package; dependent.parent_home_paid still lacks the TANF clause. T-111 explicitly schedules this sibling with the dependent pass. Its current own-funds rule can cause an over-refusal at household.hoh_fails. This ruling does not certify the dependent half as fixed.

unruled:dependent#7.evidence: Source: i2441 p. 2. dependent.dc_paid already excludes the named schooling, camp, providers, medical deduction, state reimbursement, out-of-home and care-center cases. Its care/work/qualifying-period wording covers the main-purpose and time restrictions in substance, but the explicit child-support and daily/mixed-purpose allocation detail is older low debt, now T-154; this is not disguised as an implemented screen.

unruled:dependent#8.evidence: Source: i2441 p. 3. Under recorded ambiguity amb.2025.dc_line30, dependent.dc_line2d holds the pre-benefit per-person qualified expenses and f2441.line30 subtracts f2441.line28 from their sum f2441.paid_total before feeding f2441.line3 when Part III is used. The paper line 2(d) column display is presentation under T-012.

unruled:dependent#9.evidence: Source: i2441 p. 3. f2441.line2_box checks the line 2 box when f2441.qp_count exceeds three and displays the instruction to attach a statement listing the other qualifying persons. Ordering the top three persons and serializing paper attachment rows are deferred official-form output under T-012.

unruled:dependent#10.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 17. The values sheet computes the dependent and credit predicates, but does not fill the official Form 1040 page 1 Dependents section rows, checkboxes, or overflow attachment. Official PDF filling remains T-012; this is a presentation/output gap, not a missing eligibility calculation.

unruled:dependent#11.evidence: Source: i8863 p. 3; i8863 p. 1. The American opportunity ban/prior-denial question is f8863.ban and the applicable refusal is f8863.ban_refused on the refundable and nonrefundable credit paths. dependent.edu_aoc only counts a student; it is not the final return credit. The omitted external Form 8863 gate covers this claim.

unruled:dependent#12.evidence: Source: i8863 p. 1. Recorded owner decision amb.2025.edu_1098t_date (D7(d)): i8863 p. 1 says After January 31, 2026, while the later-revised Pub. 970 p. 2 says After February 2, 2026 (January 31 falls on a Saturday). Both dependent.edu_1098t and person.edu_1098t intentionally follow Pub. 970.

unruled:f2441#1.evidence: Source: i2441 p. 2; p503 p. 10; p503 p. 8. The actual f2441.paid_total sums dependent.dc_line2d, whose underlying dc_paid question explicitly names almost all exclusions the reviewer says are missing, including care only while qualifying and so the filers can work. The residual child-support and daily/mixed-purpose detail is older low debt T-154, not a claimed implemented screen.

unruled:f2441#2.evidence: Source: i2441 p. 1; i2441 p. 3; p503 p. 3. A noncustodial parent using the divorced-parent dependency rule is refused through dependent.divorced_rule; a custodial parent unable to claim the child is refused by f2441.nondependent_gate. For supported entries, dependent.dc_qp reads claimed plus dc_child/all_year or dc_disabled_qp; these include the relevant residency, age/incapacity and TIN requirements, and dependent.dc_line2c supplies column (c). The Died entry/attachment is an excluded missing-TIN paper route. The reviewer did not receive these underlying predicates.

unruled:f2441#3.evidence: Source: i2441 p. 5; p503 p. 10. sc.special explicitly refuses contributions on the self-employed owner’s behalf to a dependent-care assistance program. Partnership benefits require Schedule K-1/E and are refused by scope.schedule1. Hence supported line 22 is zero and line 24 carries no Schedule C/E/F deduction, as the line 22 note states.

unruled:f2441#4.evidence: Source: i2441 p. 4; p503 p. 11. person.se_screen explicitly asks about Schedule SE Part II optional methods and person.se_screened refuses that regime. person.dc_earned sums person.eic_se; its source and branch logic include Schedule C profit/loss when no Schedule SE is filed, including under $400. This is not an omitted net-earnings input.

unruled:f2441#5.evidence: Source: i2441 p. 3. The provider enum explicitly offers tin, tax_exempt, lafcp, see_statement and employer, and tells the corresponding paper column (c) entries. Entering none and See W-2 on a paper form with zero providers is an official-form presentation detail under T-012 that does not alter any computed amount.

unruled:f2441#6.evidence: Source: i2441 p. 2; i2441 pp. 2-3. f2441.line1_box checks the line 1 box when f2441.provider_count exceeds three and displays the instruction to attach a statement listing the additional providers. Ordering the three highest-paid providers on the paper form and serializing attachment contents are deferred official-form output under T-012.

unruled:f2441#7.evidence: Source: i2441 p. 3. The line2_box display explicitly says attach a statement listing the other qualifying persons. dependent.dc_line2c supplies the over-12/disabled box. Ordering the top three persons and serializing attachment contents are the deferred official-form output surface, T-012.

unruled:f1040#1.evidence: Source: p501 p. 6. BUG-0280 adds the explicit divorce-to-file-unmarried-and-remarry warning to household.married ("if you divorced solely to file as unmarried, intending at the time to remarry each other in the next tax year, and actually do so, you must file as married in both years"), and BUG-0286 enforces consistency between household.married and f1040.status via household.filing_status_conflict. The f1040 completeness prompt did not include household.married’s question text.

unruled:f1040#2.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 23. scope.other_income asks about unsupported income OR RETURN TREATMENT, not merely unnamed income categories. Income/withholding belonging to a chapter 11 estate is outside the individual-return treatment implemented here. person.se_screen additionally names chapter 11 where self-employment is present.

unruled:f1040#3.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 24; i1040gi p. 25. The whole-return scope input explicitly names Form 1040 lines 1b–1d and 1f–1h, unreported wages/tips, adoption benefits and other earned income. s1.line8_other additionally names wages while incarcerated and the specified nonqualified/457 pensions; retirement.special screens pre-retirement disability pensions and corrective distributions. The reviewer missed these external scope inputs.

unruled:f1040#4.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 27; i1040gi p. 28. The per-distribution retirement.special question explicitly includes Roth rollovers, conversions/recharacterizations, returned IRA contributions, QCDs, HSA funding distributions and nondeductible IRA basis, refusing those routes before person.ira_taxable aggregates the screened retirement entries. Their line 4c boxes and statements are outside the supported regime.

unruled:f1040#5.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 28; i1040gi p. 30. The current per-distribution retirement.special question explicitly names the General Rule, public-safety officer exclusion, alternative annuity option, terrorist-attack disability pension and special survivor/beneficiary rules. These cases refuse before their taxable amounts feed person.plan_taxable.

unruled:f1040#6.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 31. ssb.pub915 explicitly includes repayments exceeding benefits, excluded adoption benefits, Forms 2555/4563/8815 and Puerto Rico exclusions; ssb.terror_disability separately asks the terrorist-attack disability exclusion. ssb.line2 refuses those answers.

unruled:f1040#7.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 26; i1040gi p. 15. div.box3 records the return-of-capital amount and div.basis_reconciled asks about the basis reduction and any excess capital gain; positive box3 without reconciliation triggers div.unsupported. Digital asset transactions are screened by scope.digital_assets, and the page 1 checkbox itself is official-PDF output under T-012.

unruled:f1040#8.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 34; i1040gi p. 33; i1040gi p. 14. A separately filing spouse is outside the tool through scope.ready/s3.mfs, so the spouse-itemizing and separate-return spouse-age/blindness exceptions are not supported computations. The ordinary age/blindness deduction is implemented in Schedule A; sa.unsupported explicitly names net qualified disaster losses added to the standard deduction.

unruled:f1040#9.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 36. The input asks ANY additional line 16 tax or filing; the listed forms are introduced with including, not an exhaustive enum. A section 965(i) triggering-event tax is an additional line 16 tax and must answer Yes. scope.ready refuses that answer.

unruled:f1040#10.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 39. Line 26 is explicitly a supplied total for this return, not a calculation assigning joint payments to former spouses. MFS returns are refused; a supported filer must supply the amount allocable to their own return. Former-spouse SSN entry belongs to the official identity/output surface T-012.

unruled:f1040#11.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 25; i1040gi p. 42; i1040gi p. 43. s8812.combat_pay explicitly asks about nontaxable combat pay (W-2 code Q), and eic.combat refuses that regime. It is not silently defaulted to the no-election case on a completed supported return.

unruled:f1040#12.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 61. f8863.ban explicitly asks whether AOC was denied/reduced after 2015 or is within a 2/10-year ban; f8863.ban_refused screens the credit paths. The household EIC/CTC ban list is not the only return refusal.

unruled:household#1.evidence: Source: p501 p. 9. The current dependent.parent_home_paid input explicitly includes paying the cost for the entire part of 2025 the parent was alive and states that a rest home or home for the elderly counts. dependent.hoh_test1 reads that answer, and household.test1_persons sums that result. This directly covers both p501 p. 9 sentences; the household-only encoding list omitted the dependent question.

unruled:household#2.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 15; p501 p. 9; p501 p. 10. dependent.months includes the qualifying-child part-year convention; dependent.hoh_lived_half additionally reads born_died/placed and part_year_home for other relatives, and dependent.hoh_test2 reads that result. Kidnapping is refused through dependent.kidnapped / qr_kidnapped, and a qualifying child of another person through dependent.other_claimant; multiple-support relatives are also refused.

unruled:household#3.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 14. i1040gi p. 14 requires the unclaimed qualifying child name in the Form 1040 entry space. This product computes a values sheet and does not fill official PDFs; TASKS T-012 retains official-PDF filling as open scope. The claim concerns that unimplemented page-entry surface, not the HOH qualification calculation.

unruled:household#4.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 15. i1040gi p. 15 requires the unclaimed qualifying child name in the Form 1040 entry space. As with claim 3, official-PDF filling remains T-012; no name-entry output is implemented or certified by the values sheet. This does not establish an error in the five-test QSS predicate.

unruled:household#5.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 39; i1040gi p. 43. Repeat of earlier rounds (r3 N1, r4 N1, r5 household#4): household.credit_disallowed asks whether EIC after 1996 or CTC/ACTC/ODC after 2015 was reduced or disallowed other than for a math or clerical error and refuses through eic.credit and s8812.line12. Omitting the prior-Form-8862 and childless-EIC carve-outs is a carried over-refusal, never a wrong amount on a completed return.

unruled:household#6.evidence: Source: i1040gi p. 13; i1040gi p. 14. scope.other_income explicitly asks about nonresident alien status of you or your spouse for any part of 2025; scope.ready refuses the return on that answer. The resident-election route described by i1040gi pp. 13–14 is outside this tool, not left unscreened by household.filing_status_conflict.
